field: Registered Nursing, Nursing Administration, Nursing Research and Clinical Nursing

location.evidence: California has the highest registered nurse wages in the country, and most of the top programs are there. Every one of the bottom programs is in Puerto Rico, where nurses earn far less than on the mainland. Low pay is the main reason Puerto Rican nurses leave for the mainland.

prestige.evidence: The best-paying programs admit a larger share of applicants than the typical nursing program, so selectivity does not explain their pay. They are mostly in California, which pays registered nurses more than any other state.

stepping_stone.evidence: Most nursing graduates go straight to work as registered nurses. A minority earn a master's or doctorate later, usually after working for some years, for roles such as nurse practitioner.

programs.evidence: Mercy University runs an online RN to BS completion program for registered nurses who already hold an associate degree or nursing diploma, so many of its graduates were already working as nurses in the New York area.

Accreditation records list Pacific College's bachelor's in nursing as an RN to BSN completion program taught by distance education. It is for nurses who are already licensed, not for students preparing for the licensing exam.

Sonoma State runs a post-licensure BSN that requires a current California RN license. Many of its graduates are working nurses finishing a bachelor's, in a Northern California market that pays nurses some of the highest wages in the country.
